Getting Started with Semantic Search

Semantic search goes beyond traditional keyword matching to understand the meaning and context of queries. This guide will help you implement semantic search in your applications.

Prerequisites

  • Python 3.10 or higher
  • Basic understanding of machine learning concepts
  • Familiarity with REST APIs

Setting Up Your Environment

First, install the required dependencies using pip: 

pip install sentence-transformers qdrant-client

These libraries provide everything you need to create embeddings and store them in a vector database.

Creating Embeddings

Embeddings convert text into numerical vectors that capture semantic meaning. Similar texts will have similar vector representations. 


from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer

model = SentenceTransformer('all-MiniLM-L6-v2')
embeddings = model.encode(['Hello world', 'Hi there'])
